Here's the fact most San Diego disposal guides get wrong: **the City of San Diego does not offer curbside bulky item pickup.** The Environmental Services Department says so directly. Measure B repealed the century-old People's Ordinance in 2022 and bulky pickup was planned to start in July 2027, but a June 2026 decision to reduce trash fees eliminated that planned service. So the articles promising "free bulky pickup in San Diego" are describing a program that doesn't exist.

## What San Diego Residents Actually Have

- **Self-haul to Miramar Landfill**, with disposal fees by load, your vehicle, and your back. Furniture is accepted.
- **Your franchise hauler**, if you live in a multi-unit property served by a private company. Some offer bulky pickup by appointment, often for a fee. Ask management what your building's contract includes.
- **Donation**, which the city itself encourages for usable furniture. A couch that [passes condition standards](/blog/eco-friendly-living/can-couch-be-donated/) can be picked up by charity programs instead of landfilled.
- **Booked removal**, which is the only option that handles the carry, the truck, and the disposal routing for a single couch on your schedule.

## The Curb Is Not an Option Here

Without a bulk program, a couch at a San Diego curb is simply illegal dumping. Coastal humidity and sun also wreck upholstery fast, so a couch left "for someone to take" loses its donation eligibility within days.

[Couch removal in San Diego](/ca/san-diego/couch-removal/) starts at $90 with carry-out included, [same-day in most ZIPs when booked before 2PM local time](/book-online/), and [donation pickup](/ca/san-diego/donation-pickup/) routes good furniture to local partners. Pricing by item is in the [cost guide](/blog/junk-removal/how-much-does-couch-removal-cost/).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does San Diego have free bulky item pickup?

No. The city does not provide curbside bulky item collection. A program was planned for 2027 under the Measure B fee structure, but a 2026 fee reduction eliminated it.

### Can I leave a couch on the curb in San Diego?

No. With no bulk collection program, a curbside couch is illegal dumping. Options are self-haul, your building's hauler, donation, or booked removal.

### Where do I take a couch in San Diego myself?

Miramar Landfill accepts furniture for a disposal fee by load. You'll need a suitable vehicle and help loading.

### What's the easiest way to get rid of a couch in San Diego?

Booked removal: [same-day across most of San Diego](/ca/san-diego/couch-removal/) when booked before 2PM local time, carried from inside your home, with donation routing first.
